description: Use this tool ONLY to get the printable data carrier (QR content) of a twin that already exists (publish_product_passports already returns one per product): a GS1 Digital Link URL (Sunrise 2027 standard) if you pass a valid GTIN, or a serialized twin URL fallback without one. The URL resolves to the product's live twin the moment it is created - it is connected, not a loose QR. Invalid GTINs are rejected before printing. Requires an authorised organisation-bound Cycle connection (OAuth or API key). OPTIONAL: pass allocation={channel|retailer, shipment?, region?, units?} to link the serial to its intended retail channel (channel-aware serialization: future scans of that unit resolve their channel, always labelled INFERRED).

gtin.description: GTIN-8/12/13/14 of the product; required to publish the passport and to build a GS1 Digital Link.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string for this request; repeating it returns the first result instead of creating a duplicate.

product_id.description: Cycle id of the product (twin) returned by create_product_twin or publish_product_passports. Give this or sku.

serial.description: Serial number of one physical unit (max 20 characters); use with granularity=item.

sku.description: Your SKU of a product that already exists in Cycle. Give this or product_id.

name: create_data_carrier
